Privacy

Who is responsible

The company identified below operates this website and controls the personal data it receives. We do not create child accounts or request children’s names, contact details or learning records. Please do not send children’s data to support.

What we collect and why

When an adult contacts us by email, we receive their email address, message and any information they choose to include. We use these details to answer the request and provide support. Our hosting provider may process an IP address, request time and browser information to deliver and protect the website. Depending on the purpose, processing is based on steps requested before a contract or its performance, a legal obligation, the establishment or protection of rights, or a legitimate interest that does not override the person's rights. Paid checkout and online activation are not active on this website. Before they open, we will explain the data they require and the providers involved.

Sharing and retention

Only authorised people and service providers that need information to operate hosting or email and answer your request may receive it. Information may also be disclosed where the law requires. We retain it only for the relevant purpose and applicable legal obligations or claims, then delete or anonymise it. We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising profiles. International transfers, if arranged, must have a valid basis and the safeguards required by applicable law.

Your rights

Under Turkish KVKK, you may ask whether your personal data is processed, obtain information about its purpose and recipients, request correction or erasure where the legal conditions apply and notification of those changes to recipients, object to an adverse result based solely on automated analysis, and seek compensation for unlawful processing. Contact privacy@horizons-tr.com or send a written request to the company address on our legal-information page. We may request proportionate identity verification and respond to KVKK requests within 30 days. You may complain to the competent authority using its applicable procedure. Additional rights, including restriction or portability, apply where the relevant law provides them.

Cookies and local storage

Our website code uses no advertising trackers or analytics and does not store a language preference; the language is part of the URL. The online workbook sample may save learning progress and preferences in your browser on this device. The downloaded workbook also saves progress locally. Hosting or access-protection services may use technically necessary data or cookies. Optional update checks are off by default and require your choice. Any future external checkout will have its own privacy and cookie information.
